cases.sentence: Твой слуга — среди Твоего народа, который Ты избрал, ___, слишком многочисленного, чтобы его пересчитать или исчислить.
cases.explain: «великого народа» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Your servant is among your people which you have chosen, a great people, that can’t be numbered or counted for multitude.

cases.explain: «многочисленным народом» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Give your servant therefore an understanding heart to judge your people, that I may discern between good and evil; for who is able to judge this great people of yours?”
